title: English Practice Quiz 0216
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.
